profile.summary: My School RD is a consulting firm that helps schools run their nutrition programs. Its services include nutrient analysis, meal pattern compliance, administrative reviews, training and special diet support. It is led by a Registered Dietitian who previously worked on school meal audits for the California Department of Education.
